summary: Preserves the global flag byte byte_7C56C0, selects the vehicle-setup file path (*this, or the default application directory byte_5EA438 when *this is null), calls VehicleSetupFileWriter(flag, path, 1) to load the setup file, then restores byte_7C56C0 to its pre-call value. Returns the VehicleSetupFileWriter result. The flag is saved and restored so the file-load call does not permanently alter the global flag state.

operations.description: Save the current global flag byte byte_7C56C0 into a local before the load so it can be restored afterwards.
Guard on the path string: when *this is null, fall back to &byte_5EA438 (the default application directory).
Call VehicleSetupFileWriter(&byte_7C56C0, path, 1) to load the vehicle setup file with flag parameter 1; store its return value as result.
Restore byte_7C56C0 to the value saved before the call.
Called by sub_4A00A0 (0x004A00A0) as part of a vehicle setup load path.

unresolved: Semantics of the flag parameter 1 passed to VehicleSetupFileWriter are unknown.
Meaning of byte_7C56C0's flag bits and why the caller needs it preserved around the load is unknown.
Owner object is unknown; the __thiscall receiver this is only used as a path-string holder.
